6aus45 – Help

Open help with F1 or Help → Help. No bets are placed and no tickets are purchased.

File → Build / resume inventory creates all 8,145,060 Lotto combinations and 1,000,000 Joker numbers. Committed batches survive cancellation. The delivered inventory is already complete.

Draws displays 100 rows per page. Use Analysis → Next/Previous 100 results. Click a column header to sort the displayed page. Selecting a Lotto draw shows white main balls and a green extra ball. Only ascending Lotto results are imported; Joker digits and leading zeroes remain unchanged.

Statistics: enter From/To as dd.mm.yyyy; empty fields mean all dates and last N=0 means all draws. Press F5 after changes. Select frequencies, pairs, triplets, shapes, repeated results or comparison periods. Boundary gaps remain incomplete. Joker statistics keep digit positions and suffix lengths separate.

Tip generation: select count (default 10), game and optional seed. Statistical rules and exclusions are off by default. Analysis → Generate tips saves a series. Hard JSON rules: include/exclude, even, sum_min/sum_max, neighbors_max, regions, overlap_max. Example: {"include":[1],"even":3,"sum_min":100,"sum_max":180}. weight=frequent/rare/absent is a soft weight. Rules are never silently relaxed. Overlap-constrained search has a finite budget and may stop without a series.

My tips: select a series identifier; Analysis → Match active series compares main Lotto hits and consecutive Joker suffix hits. No prize amounts are inferred from hit counts.

Data → Import file previews a file. Confirm previewed import writes draws. Verified Win2day Lotto CSV epochs, annual Joker PDFs, JSON and documented interchange CSV are supported. Online refresh discovers official archive links and re-imports all years with duplicate protection, covering earlier gaps too. Conflicts require review and a reasoned manual correction.

File → Export results offers CSV, JSON, HTML and TXT. All results streams the whole active draw dataset or tip series; displayed results exports the current filtered/sorted page. Statistics exports the selected analysis. HTML embeds the wolf-and-D watermark.

File → Back up database uses the SQLite backup API. Restore checks schema and integrity and backs up the current database first. Select database stores a different path. Settings controls language and update checks; no update download is available until a repository has been published.

Statistics describe the past and do not improve winning chances. Lotto: 1 in 8,145,060; full Joker: 1 in 1,000,000. Imported history: Lotto from 07.09.1986, Joker from 02.10.1988 through 04.10.2026. The archived databases were transferred with prizes and provenance.

Payouts and sources

Under Draws, expand “Prize payouts for selected draw” to see documented winners and amounts. ATS and EUR remain separate; a jackpot pool is not a per-winner payout. A dash means not published. File → Settings lets you add, edit, remove and enable draw sources. Supported formats include official Lotto CSV archives, Joker yearly PDF/CSV files, the official Joker result service and the documented JSON/CSV interchange. Local archived or current 6aus45 databases can also be transferred via Data → Import file after preview. Data → Update draws loads enabled sources. Other website formats require a matching parser. Sorted Lotto numbers use white balls, the extra number green and Joker digits blue. Generated tips immediately show ball images in My tips; the first row is also previewed under tip generation.

Empty columns on the displayed page are hidden automatically. They reappear when populated, including after filtering and switching between Lotto and Joker. The date column is compact.

The source list in Settings contains only a checkbox and a link per row. Tick the checkbox to enable the source; + adds a link and − removes it. Save settings applies the changes; Cancel discards them.

Column widths are fixed and do not change when switching analyses. Joker analyses are available only when Joker is selected. Lotto shows only applicable Lotto analyses. Changing the game or analysis immediately updates the displayed results.
